name: each component picks its cheapest outgoing edge
mechanism: in rounds, every component selects the cheapest edge leaving it and all selected edges are added at once, at least halving the number of components per round

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Borůvka's algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Routing for graphs:

requires: distinct edge weights or a tie-break
fails_when: ties without a tie-break can create cycles
